inputs.name: adaptersForProfile.profile
inputs.description: A concrete audit profile used to filter the adapter registry. The auto profile is excluded and cannot be supplied here.

inputs.name: adapterForExtension.extension
inputs.description: The file extension searched within adapters selected for the requested profile. Matching uses exact string inclusion.

inputs.name: adapterForExtension.profile
inputs.description: A concrete audit profile used to select the adapters searched for the extension. The auto profile is excluded and cannot be supplied here.

inputs.name: resolveAuditProfile.root
inputs.description: Repository root path consulted when profile is auto. Detection checks package.json harness.kind, contract directories, and Svelte markers.

inputs.name: resolveAuditProfile.profile
inputs.description: The audit profile to return directly, or auto to detect a profile from the repository root. It defaults to auto.

outputs.name: auditAdapters
outputs.description: The ordered registry of imported audit adapter implementations. It is the source list filtered by profile and extension lookup.

outputs.name: adaptersForProfile
outputs.description: The adapters whose profiles include the requested profile, preserving registry order. The result scopes the later extension lookup.

outputs.name: adapterForExtension
outputs.description: The first adapter in the profile-filtered registry whose extensions include the supplied string, or undefined when none matches.

outputs.name: knownAuditExtensions
outputs.description: The deduplicated extensions declared by registered adapters together with the built-in future extensions. First occurrence order is preserved.

outputs.name: resolveAuditProfile
outputs.description: The supplied concrete profile, or the profile detected from the repository root when the input is auto. Detection checks Harness package kind, contract workspace markers, and Svelte app markers.
